message: Hats off to **raquaza**, holding strong at the top with a whopping 12,225 trophies — our top *Goblin Barrel* specialist! And shoutout to **Chanco**, who’s pulled ahead with an impressive 202 donations, showing true *Baby Dragon* prowess. *JaxikoLane* isn’t far behind, keeping pace with 212 donations and mastering the art of the *Dart Goblin*. Our River Race gladiators — *King Levy*, *raquaza*, *JaxikoLane*, *Chanco*, and *King Thing* — have led the charge today. For those yet to dive in, there’s still plenty of battle left. Let's keep our **towers intact**, and our *Inferno Dragons* roaring! Let's make this race ours! 🔥
